risks

riskmitigation
CARE runs multiple web/celery instances; gateway ledger is file-basedLedger dir on a shared volume; NHCX_ROLE=1 on exactly one celery beat instance for refresher/pruner (OPERATIONS.md)
CARE conditions are SNOMED onlyICD-10 chosen per claim on S4 (D25)
No sandbox credentials available in this environmentL7 dry-run with a fake gateway; L8 blocked until credentials provided
Gateway send must never run inside a DB transaction (ATOMIC_REQUESTS)Service views decorated with transaction.non_atomic_requests; tests assert not in_atomic_block

corrections

(none)

decisions

[

 {
  "spec": "F11",
  "what": "claim_ref: take Task/CommunicationRequest identifier values first, then the first reference value with no '/' or ':' (the literal rule picked urn:uuid references)",
  "source": "nhcx-package 1.0.0 fhir/C6 examples"
 },
 {
  "spec": "F11",
  "what": "request_id falls back to the CommunicationRequest fullUrl's last segment; the PMJAY notification has no id",
  "source": "fhir/C6/C6-notification-wfN02.json"
 },
 {
  "spec": "F12",
  "what": "acknowledgement reuses the request bundle identifier only when it has a value; otherwise {payer_system, '<claim_no>-N<query_id>'}",
  "source": "fhir/C6 PMJAY notification has identifier without value"
 },
 {
  "spec": "F12",
  "what": "B4 example carries inResponseTo; F12 omits it and F12 was followed",
  "source": "fhir/B4 example"
 },
 {
  "spec": "F9",
  "what": "workflow id map from PAYERS.md applied before the outcome/reason table; error header/error[] always wins; partial outcome keeps an approval as partial",
  "source": "PAYERS.md, fhir/C5,C7 examples"
 },
 "nhcxApi.getPractitioner/updatePractitioner TRes is {ok, message, profile} (backend views_global.PractitionerProfileView), not a bare profile.",
 "A19 actions also include 'suggestions' and 'address' (backend AbhaView) beyond the six listed in CONTRACT.md; the S14 create flow needs them to choose an ABHA address.",
 "Backend extras used though not in CONTRACT.md: POST claims/{id}/discharge/ (S11 discharge details) and POST claims/{id}/queries/{query_id}/ack/ (S10 send acknowledgement).",
 {
  "spec": "G3",
  "what": "G3 lists live.abdm.gov.in for the production sessions URL; G2/CORE give apis.abdm.gov.in/api/hiecm/gateway/v3/sessions. Used G2 (config is the single source of defaults).",
  "source": "G2 ENV table, CORE.md"
 },
 {
  "spec": "G4",
  "what": "G4 gives apis.abdm.gov.in/pmjay/hcx as production registry base; G2 gives apisprod.nha.gov.in/pmjay/hcx/participanthcxservice. Used G2.",
  "source": "G2 ENV table"
 },
 {
  "spec": "G8",
  "what": "G8D prose says an unmatched message writes no row, but the G8 pseudocode/table record it as delivered. Followed the pseudocode: every inbound is recorded (status delivered, peer.outcome=unmatched).",
  "source": "G8 pseudocode"
 },
 {
  "spec": "G8",
  "what": "Inbound also accepts a flattened JWE (protected/encrypted_key/iv/ciphertext/tag) and cleartext type:ProtocolResponse bodies (payloadType protocol).",
  "source": "nhcx-docs MCP (protocol error responses)"
 },
 {
  "spec": "G2",
  "what": "Keys starting with $comment are allowed anywhere in the config so the example file can document every key; all other unknown keys are still rejected.",
  "source": "implementation decision"
 },
 {
  "spec": "G1",
  "what": "In CARE the G1 background loops run as Celery beat tasks (care.nhcx.tasks.refresh_tokens every 60 s, prune_ledger hourly, check_gateway on worker_ready), only where settings.NHCX_ROLE is true. Gateway.start()/stop() keep the thread loops for hosts without Celery.",
  "source": "SCAFFOLDING 7, task brief"
 },
 {
  "spec": "G7",
  "what": "send() refuses to run inside a caller's atomic block (SendInTransactionError, a RuntimeError, not a SendError); atomic blocks opened by Django TestCase (_from_testcase) are ignored so services stay testable.",
  "source": "SCAFFOLDING 8"
 },
 {
  "spec": "G9",
  "what": "Ledger is safe across processes (gunicorn workers + celery): an fcntl lock on <dir>/.lock around id allocation and writes, and each reader refreshes its in-memory index incrementally from <day>/index.jsonl before queries.",
  "source": "implementation decision (multi-process deployment)"
 },
 {
  "spec": "G3",
  "what": "Session tokens are also shared through Django's default cache (settings.NHCX_SHARED_TOKEN_CACHE, default true) so the refresher process warms tokens for web workers.",
  "source": "implementation decision"
 },
 {
  "spec": "G5",
  "what": "x-hcx-timestamp and the acceptance timestamp use the Django time zone (Asia/Kolkata in CARE) rather than the container's process zone; @hcx suffix detection is case-insensitive.",
  "source": "implementation decision"
 },
 "D9 ix_claim_status prefixed with facility (multi-facility); extra index on Claim.correlation_id",
 "D9/D31 created_at/updated_at mapped to EMRBaseModel created_date/modified_date",
 "D1/D2 name/phone/address come from Facility/User; is_default and consultation_fee omitted",
 "D26 practitioner FK -> users.User; D31 requested_by FK -> users.User (spec TEXT)",
 "D30 Counter is plain models.Model with name PK (not EMRBaseModel)",
 "Payer-sourced FHIR date strings (D9 plan_period_*, patient_dob, D21 payment_date, D22 date) kept as CharField",
 "NhcxBaseModel.delete() is a hard delete, because specs delete and reinsert rows under unique keys",
 {
  "spec": "API auth",
  "what": "Anonymous requests get 403 (not_authenticated), not 401: CARE's authenticators return an empty WWW-Authenticate header, so DRF downgrades the status platform-wide.",
  "source": "config/authentication.py authenticate_header"
 }
]
